notes: «وبهذا الإسناد» takes over prev1, which writes its chain; the text names Ahmad al-Mithami right after it, so the three names of prev1 before him are inherited
How far «بهذا الإسناد» carries prev1 beyond Ahmad is my reading, not certain; the inherited prefix is the only part taken over
«عن أبي جعفر ع» is inside the chain after «عن», so a narrator; the saying after «قال» is the Imam's
